description: List the model runs Studio started for this key's account (images, videos, audio, text), newest first, with their status, output URLs, text answers and cost. It covers all of your Studio conversations in this key's workspace; teammates' runs are not included. Use it to collect outputs that finished after a turn ended, or to check what is still running. Each run shows when it was created and, for a model that takes a prompt, its prompt, so it can be matched to a request. These runs belong to Studio, so get_task, list_tasks, cancel_task and kill_task cannot read or stop them; poll this tool instead. It reads at most Studio's 100 most recent runs: to collect a period, pass since with limit 100, and the result says when older runs in that period may be missing. Only successful runs are charged. Read-only.

limit.description: How many recent runs to read (1-100, default 20). Filters apply after reading, so fewer can come back.

since.description: Only runs created at or after this time: ISO 8601 (2026-01-31T09:00:00Z) or Unix seconds.

state.description: Only runs in this state (default all).

name: list_studio_results
title: List Studio model runs
